player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaikaiwhakaari {player_id} i roto i tētahi Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma e whāiti ana ki {num_rounds} rauniga.

Te Hanganga o te Tākaro:
- I mua i tēnei whakatau ka whai wā koe ki {total_conversation_rounds} whakatau ki te kōrero noa.
- I muri i taua mea, ka whakatau ngātahi ngā kaiwhakaari ki te mahi tahi rānei ki te whakakore.

Te Pūaranga o ngā Utu (whakapūmau ia rauniga):
- Ka mahi tahi ngā Kaikaiwhakaari e rua ➜ ia tangata {cooperate_reward}
- Ka whakakore ngā Kaikaiwhakaari e rua ➜ ia tangata {mutual_defect_reward}
- Ka whakakore tetahi, ka mahi tahi tetahi ➜ Kaikaiwhakaari whakakore {defect_reward}, Kaikaiwhakaari mahi tahi {sucker_reward}

Me pehea te tākaro:
- I te wā o te kōrero: tuhi tetahi tuhinga e hiahia ana koe.
- I te wā o te whakatau: whakauru '[Cooperate]' rānei '[Defect]' (kore rawa te take). Ka taea te whakauru i etahi atu tuhinga i mua o / i muri o te tohu.

phases.conversation_finished: Kua mutu te kōrero mō te rauniga {round}. Tēnā whakautu ki '[Cooperate]' rānei '[Defect]' ki roto i \boxed{{}}.

outcome.draw: He toenga! I eke nga kaitakaro e rua {s0}.
outcome.round_both_cooperate: I mahi tahi ngā kaitākaro e rua.
outcome.round_both_defect: I rere atu ngā kaitākaro e rua.
outcome.round_p0_cooperates_p1_defects: I mahi tahi te kaitākaro 0, i rere atu te kaitakaro 1.
outcome.round_p0_defects_p1_cooperates: I rere te kaitākaro 0 i a ia, ka mahi tahi te kaitakaro 1.
